name: avenir-mcp
description: An unofficial MCP server for YNAB, built for agents: read-only by default, every change previewed, confirmed and undoable.

paragraphs: Self-checked on every change against YNAB's API terms of 2025-05-28 (naming, attribution, YNAB's own image, a personal token for its owner only, the hourly limit); a weekly job turns the badge red when YNAB changes its terms. Listed by YNAB in its Works with YNAB directory, among third-party apps. Not endorsed by YNAB.
Built and tested against YNAB's API v1.87.0. A weekly YNAB API drift check compares it with the live specification and fails when YNAB publishes a new version.

requirements.text: Ask Claude — or any MCP client — about your plan in plain words: where the money went, what still needs a category, whether an account matches the bank, when money would run out.
You need uv and a YNAB personal access token (YNAB → Account Settings → Developer Settings → New Token).
